products.title: Giorgio Armani Sì Passione EDP
products.description:
Giorgio Armani Sì Passione Eau de Parfum (EDP) is a vibrant, bold, and fiercely feminine flanker launched in 2018. Described by the house as an "irresistible combination of grace, strength, and independent spirit," it strips away the heavy, syrupy patchouli depth of the original Sì and replaces it with a bright, clean, and energizing burst of juicy fruits and fresh florals.

The bottle is an absolute showstopper, featuring an inner lacquering of brilliant, fiery red that perfectly captures the "passione" theme, contrasted by the line's iconic sculpted black gemstone cap.

 

Scent Profile & Notes

Sì Passione steps away from the classic chypre category, leaning heavily into a bright, contemporary fruity-floral-woody direction.

  • Top Notes: Pear, Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper, Grapefruit

  • Heart Notes: Rose, Pineapple, Heliotrope, Jasmine

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Cedarwood, Amberwood, Patchouli

What It Smells Like

The opening is instantly uplifting and bright. A crisp, sweet sparkling pear takes center stage, blended with the line's signature blackcurrant and a touch of spicy pink pepper for an energetic kick.

As the scent develops, a tropical twist of juicy pineapple merges with a classic romantic heart of rose and jasmine. The powdery heliotrope gives it a subtle, clean texture.

The dry-down is exceptionally smooth and intimate. Instead of a heavy, dark patchouli base, Passione relies on clean, dry cedarwood and soft vanilla. It loses the rich, jammy liqueur-like density of the original Sì, turning instead into a clean, shampoo-fresh, and sophisticated daytime fruit blend.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Spring, Summer, and Fall. Its airy, fruit-forward composition shines beautifully in warm, sunny weather without ever becoming thick or cloying.

  • Occasion: An incredible everyday signature scent. Perfect for the office, casual daytime outings, brunch, or whenever you want an effortless "clean and expensive" aura.

  • Longevity: Moderate. It stays closer to the skin than the original Sì, lasting around 5 to 6 hours. It forms a polite, sophisticated personal scent bubble (sillage) rather than taking over a room.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Sì EDP
products.description:
Giorgio Armani Sì Eau de Parfum (EDP) is a flagship pillar in modern feminine perfumery. Launched in 2013 and famously fronted by Cate Blanchett, it is a sophisticated, chic, and sultry chypre-fruity fragrance that represents Italian elegance. It balances a deep, sweet fruitiness with an earthy, sensual dry-down.

The bottle reflects this architectural minimalism: a structured, heavy clear glass base containing a soft nude-pink juice, crowned by a glossy, organic black cap that resembles a sculpted gemstone.

 

Scent Profile & Notes

Sì is best known for its unconventional structure, blending a sweet liqueur-like opening with clean florals and a dark, grounding wood base.

  • Top Notes: Cassis (Blackcurrant Nectar)

  • Heart Notes: May Rose, Freesia

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Ambroxan, Woody Notes

What It Smells Like

The opening is bold, distinct, and immediately recognizable, driven by an intense burst of cassis (blackcurrant nectar). It smells rich, jammy, and slightly tart—almost like a high-end blackcurrant liqueur.

As the initial fruitiness softens, the fragrance reveals a highly sophisticated heart of fresh May rose and clean, airy freesia.

The dry-down is where Sì gains its signature addictive warmth. A smooth, warm patchouli grounds the entire composition, cutting through what could have been a basic fruit scent to add a slightly green, earthy depth. This is wrapped in a creamy blanket of vanilla and clean ambroxan, leaving a powdery, musky, and completely refined trail that screams luxury.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Fall, Winter, and Spring. Its rich sweetness can feel a bit too heavy during hot, humid summer days, but it is gorgeous in crisp weather.

  • Occasion: Incredibly versatile. It is refined enough for executive office wear and everyday signature use, yet sultry and deep enough for formal evening events and dates.

  • Longevity: Strong. It behaves like a true, high-quality EDP, giving a solid 7 to 8 hours of longevity on the skin with an elegant, projecting scent bubble that leaves a memorable impression.

products.title: Armani Code Profumo EDP
products.description:
Armani Code Profumo is a legendary, ultra-masculine flanker in the iconic Armani Code lineup. Launched in 2016, it is celebrated as an absolute powerhouse of a fragrance that blends a warm, amber-heavy sweetness with the classic, clean, and powdery DNA of the original Code line.

Note: While often casually referred to by enthusiasts as an EDP due to its incredible performance and richness, it was technically released as a high-concentration Parfum formulation before eventually being discontinued to make room for newer reformulations.

The bottle perfectly mirrors its fiery, evening-centric character, featuring the signature Code tuxedo-silhouette wrapped in a rich, glowing amber-bronze gradient with a textured black cummerbund neck ring.

 

Scent Profile & Notes

Profumo dials down the traditional sharp citrus of the original Code, replacing it with a rich, soda-like effervescence and a massive, resinous base.

  • Top Notes: Green Mandarin, Green Apple, Cardamom

  • Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Lavender, Orange Blossom

  • Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Amber, Leather

What It Smells Like

The opening is uniquely striking: a bright burst of crisp green apple and mandarin layered over warm cardamom, creating a fizzy vibe that many enthusiasts famously compare to a premium "root beer" or "Dr Pepper" float.

As it develops, the fragrance introduces a clean, soapy heart of lavender and orange blossom, which quickly surrenders to a massive, seductive base. The star here is an intense dose of sweet tonka bean and warm amber, darkened beautifully by a smooth, masculine leather accord. The dry-down is incredibly rich, creamy, and warm, leaving a powdery, sweet-spicy trail.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Winter and Late Autumn. Its thick, warm profile cuts through freezing air like a knife, but it is way too heavy for hot summer days.

  • Occasion: Nightlife, clubbing, winter date nights, and formal cold-weather events. It is unashamedly a "loud" fragrance meant to get noticed.

  • Longevity: Elite level. Easily lasts 8 to 10+ hours on skin, with massive projection and an intoxicating scent trail (sillage) during the first few hours.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Code EDP
products.description:
Emporio Armani Because It's You Eau de Parfum (EDP) is the feminine counterpart to the Stronger With You men's line, launched together in 2017 as a duo meant to represent a modern love story. It is a delicious, sparkling, and deeply romantic fruity-floral fragrance built around a core of sweet raspberry and elegant rose.

The bottle mirrors the clean curves and premium glass weight of the men's collection, topped with a distinctive silver cap encircled by entwined rings that symbolize shared connection.

 

Scent Profile & Notes

Because It's You balances bright, juicy top fruits with a sophisticated, creamy dry-down that prevents it from turning into a simple candy-like scent.

  • Top Notes: Raspberry, Neroli, Lemon

  • Heart Notes: Rose

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Amberwood

What It Smells Like

The opening is instantly captivating, presenting a bright, juicy ripe raspberry mixed with a crisp splash of lemon and clean, green neroli. As the sharp fruitiness rounds out, a beautifully romantic, fresh rose heart emerges, making the composition feel incredibly elegant and feminine.

The base structure relies heavily on a soft, addictive blend of creamy vanilla and white musk, grounded lightly by amberwood. It feels playful and sweet but carries a sophisticated, powdery texture that makes it highly seductive.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Exceptionally versatile. It is bright enough for Spring and Summer days, yet has enough vanilla depth to warm up cooler Fall and Winter weather.

  • Occasion: Highly multi-purpose—perfect as a signature everyday office scent, brunch dates, or elegant evening outings.

  • Longevity: Impressive performance. Because of its Eau de Parfum concentration, it lasts solidly for 6 to 8 hours on skin and clings beautifully to clothes, creating a delightfully sweet, soft sillage trail.

products.title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Sandal Wood EDP
products.description:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Sandalwood Eau de Parfum (EDP) is a highly sought-after, regional exclusive flanker launched in 2025. Following the tradition of the line’s premium Middle Eastern editions, it shifts the focus away from loud, sugary designer sweetness toward a sophisticated, creamy, and niche-quality profile.

The aesthetics of the release match its desert-inspired mystique: the juice is housed in a striking, deep forest green lacquered bottle accented with elegant gold lettering, entwined rings, and gold Arabic calligraphy.

Scent Profile & Notes

Sandalwood tones down the ultra-dense vanilla and sticky fruits of earlier flankers, introducing a sophisticated contrast between sharp spices, smooth wood, and clean aromatics.

  • Top Notes: Saffron

  • Heart Notes: Chestnut (Sugar-Coated Accord), Lavender

  • Base Notes: Sandalwood, Bourbon Vanilla, Cedarwood

What It Smells Like

The fragrance opens with an elegant, smooth burst of saffron, which provides a slightly leathery, bittersweet, and rich introduction. As the opening settles, a clean, aromatic lavender emerges alongside the iconic, signature sugar-coated chestnut accord.

In the dry-down, the star ingredient takes center stage. The sandalwood here is soft, milky, and incredibly creamy. Combined with a balanced dose of bourbon vanilla and dry cedarwood, the overall composition feels much more texturized, powdery, and refined than the original EDT. It is significantly less heavy, letting the woody elements breathe rather than drowning them in thick syrup.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Fall, Winter, and cooler Spring days.

  • Occasion: Upscale casual, intimate dates, elegant evening events, or lounge settings.

  • Longevity: Great. It relies on heavy base resins and solid woods, easily providing 7 to 9 hours on skin. It has a more intimate, sophisticated bubble (sillage) compared to the roaring projection of Intensely, making it highly wearable and smooth.

products.title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber EDP
products.description:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum (EDP) is a luxurious, region-exclusive flanker launched in 2023. This edition infuses the signature nutty sweetness of the original collection with a premium, golden oriental amber accord, creating an incredibly rich, warm, and comforting scent bubble.

The bottle matches this opulent shift, featuring a brilliant, warm amber-toned juice paired with an elegant gold-toned cap and matching metallic accents.

 

Scent Profile & Notes

Amber simplifies the complex fruity notes of previous flankers, choosing instead to focus heavily on resinous warmth and clean aromatics.

  • Top Notes: Lavender

  • Heart Notes: Madagascar Vanilla

  • Base Notes: Amber

What It Smells Like

The opening is smooth and unexpectedly clean, courtesy of a high-quality, aromatic lavender. This fresh introduction quickly gives way to a massive heart of creamy, rich Madagascar vanilla.

As it fully dries down, the star of the show emerges: a deep, resinous, and enveloping amber accord. While you still feel the subtle, sweet, and nutty structural backbone that makes it unmistakably a Stronger With You fragrance, the emphasis here is entirely on a smooth, warm, and almost honeyed glow. It is significantly less spicy than the original EDT, trading sharp edges for soft, luxurious warmth.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Fall and Winter. It feels tailor-made for freezing temperatures and crisp evening air.

  • Occasion: Formal events, elegant evening gatherings, upscale dates, or anytime you want a luxurious, sophisticated aura.

  • Longevity: Elite. Because it relies heavily on dense resins and vanilla base notes, it easily clocks 8 to 10+ hours on skin. It projects beautifully without being harsh or scratchy, leaving a smooth, radiant trail.

products.title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Parfum
products.description:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Parfum is a darker, more sophisticated addition to the line. It transitions the gourmand, youthful sweetness of the original into a refined, high-end signature profile.

The bottle features the classic silhouette but is elevated with a distinct, deep amber-to-black gradient lacquering and a sleek, blackened-silver cap.

Scent Profile & Notes

The Parfum concentration swaps out the airy violet leaves and light fruits of earlier versions for a dense, aromatic opening and a rich, texturized base.

  • Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Mandarin Orange

  • Heart Notes: Lavender, Cinnamon, Sage

  • Base Notes: Marron Glacé (Crystallized Chestnut), Bourbon Vanilla, Leather Accord

What It Smells Like

The fragrance opens with a sharp flash of spicy pink pepper balanced by tangy mandarin, immediately signaling a punchier, more mature character. The heart transitions into a highly aromatic blend of lavender and sage, warmed up significantly by a ribbon of cinnamon.

The real magic happens in the dry-down. While the iconic sugared chestnut and premium bourbon vanilla remain the structural backbone, they are wrapped tightly in a velvety, soft leather accord. This addition cuts down the bubblegum-like sweetness found in the EDT, replacing it with a smoky, ultra-masculine, and near-niche woodiness.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Late Autumn and Winter. The dense, deep composition thrives in crisp, freezing air.

  • Occasion: Intimate date nights, formal evening events, upscale lounge outings, or whenever you want to project confidence and sophistication.

  • Longevity: Exceptional. As a true Parfum, it sets a heavy, slow-evaporating scent bubble. Expect 9 to 11+ hours on skin, with an incredibly seductive trail (sillage) that lingers subtly rather than screaming for attention.

products.title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze EDT
products.description:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze is a refreshing, citrus-forward flanker launched in 2020. It takes the signature warm, sweet DNA of the original Stronger With You and twists it into a brighter, cooler version designed to perform in warmer weather.

Visually capturing this shift, the juice is housed in a distinct frosted glass bottle to represent the "frozen" concept.

 

Scent Profile & Notes

Freeze dials back the heavy ambery heat of the original, replacing it with a sharp, zesty opening and an airy, clean dry-down.

  • Top Notes: Lime, Ginger, Mandarin Orange, Apple

  • Heart Notes: Lavender, Sage, Geranium, Cardamom

  • Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Amberwood, Marron Glacé (Candied Chestnut), Guaiac Wood

What It Smells Like

The opening is highly energetic, dominated by a crisp, sharp lime and fresh ginger combination. As the citrus settles, the clean, aromatic heart of lavender and sage takes over.

Crucially, the DNA of the original isn't entirely lost—you still get hints of that signature sweet vanilla and candied chestnut in the background, but it is heavily toned down and smoothed out by amberwood. It feels like a fresh, frosted breeze blowing through a warm bakery.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Spring and Summer. Unlike the rest of the line, this is specifically engineered to handle warmer days without becoming cloying.

  • Occasion: Casual daytime wear, office environments, and warm summer evenings out.

  • Longevity: Moderate. It projects strongly during its crisp opening but settles closer to the skin, lasting around 5 to 6 hours on average.

Key Takeaway: If you love the core sweet signature of the Stronger With You line but want something light, uplifting, and versatile enough to wear to the office or on a warm day, Freeze bridges that gap perfectly.

products.title: Emporio Armani Stronger With You EDT
products.description:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette (EDT) is a warm, magnetic, and highly seductive designer fragrance known for its rich blend of sweet spices and cozy wood notes. Launched in 2017, it has become a modern staple for fall, winter, and date-night wear.

 

Scent Profile & Notes

The fragrance opens with an energetic burst of fresh spices and herbs, quickly settling into a signature sweet, nutty, and resinous heart.

  • Top Notes: Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Violet Leaf, Mint

  • Heart Notes: Chestnut (Glacé Accord), Pineapple, Sage, Melon, Cinnamon

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Amberwood, Cedar, Guaiac Wood

What It Smells Like

The standout characteristic of Stronger With You is its smoky, candied chestnut accord mixed with smooth vanilla. While the initial spray offers a brief freshness from the pink pepper and mint, it rapidly evolves into a deep, cozy, and ambery sweetness. The dry-down balances this sugar with dry cedar and amberwood, ensuring it retains a distinctively masculine edge.

Performance & Versatility

  • Season: Autumn and Winter. It can easily become overpowering in high heat due to its dense sweetness.

  • Occasion: Date nights, evening outings, clubbing, and casual cold-weather wear.

  • Longevity: Outstanding for an Eau de Toilette—typically lasting 7 to 9 hours on the skin, with powerful projection (sillage) during the first few hours.

products.title: Tom Ford Bitter Peach EDP
products.description:
Tom Ford Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum is a loud, explicit, and wildly intoxicating fragrance from the Private Blend collection. It completely flips the script on typical fruity scents; instead of smelling like a simple, innocent, or sugary orchard peach, this fragrance captures the aroma of a peach at its peak, dripping-ripe sweetness, spiked with dark boozy alcohols and sharp, earthy resins.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Fruity Amber / Boozy Gourmand

  • Top Notes: Pêche de Vigne (Vine Peach), Sicilian Blood Orange, Cardamom, Heliotrope

  • Heart Notes: Boozy Cognac, Rich Dark Rum, Davana, Jasmine Sambac

  • Base Notes: Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Madagascar Vanilla, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Styrax, Cashmeran

Profile & Behavior

Bitter Peach opens with a massive, hyper-potent burst of fleshy vine peach and tart Sicilian blood orange. The sweetness is immediate and nectar-like, but it is instantly cut by a sharp, spicy bite of cardamom that gives it that "bitter" edge.

As it develops on the skin, the fragrance turns beautifully dark and decadent. A heavy pour of rum and cognac enters the mix, transforming the fruitiness into a sophisticated, intoxicating cocktail. The dry-down settles into a luxurious, warm bed of rich Indonesian patchouli, smooth vanilla, and resinous benzoin. The patchouli adds a damp, woody depth that balances out the sweetness, making it complex and incredibly high-status.

  • Vibe: Provocative, indulgent, fiercely stylish, and unapologetically bold.

  • Seasonality & Wear: A rare fruit-forward fragrance that performs spectacularly all year round. It has the vibrant fruit signature for warm, upscale summer evenings, yet boasts enough boozy, resinous depth to cut beautifully through the autumn and winter cold.

  • Presentation: Housed in a stunningly designed Private Blend bottle featuring a translucent outer glass shell with an opaque, vibrant orange inner lacquer that perfectly captures the bold, juicy character of the scent.

products.title: GIORGIO ARMANI Acqua Di Gio Profumo EDP
products.description:
Acqua Di Giò Profumo by Giorgio Armani – Parfum Pour Homme

Product Description

Experience a legendary masterpiece born from volcanic rock and deep ocean waters with Acqua Di Giò Profumo. This highly coveted, elegant fragrance represents the pinnacle of dark aquatic intensity, effortlessly contrasting crisp, airy freshness with a deeply sensual, smoky heat. A signature scent created for the sophisticated and adventurous man, it commands a powerful, timeless presence that makes it a true holy grail in modern perfumery.

The fragrance opens with an immediate wave of fresh marine accords and a sharp splash of Calabrian bergamot. Its complex, masculine heart reveals a clean aromatic blend of rosemary, fresh sage, and crisp geranium. The composition reaches its legendary dry down on a base of rich, dark patchouli and burning incense, leaving an incredibly luxurious, long-lasting, and hypnotic trail.

Fragrance Profile

  • Top Notes: Sea Notes, Bergamot

  • Heart Notes: Rosemary, Sage, Geranium

  • Base Notes: Incense, Patchouli

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Giorgio Armani

  • Concentration: Parfum / Extrait de Parfum (often styled as EDP due to its rich intensity)

  • Formulation: Pour Homme (For Men)

  • Scent Family: Aromatic Aquatic / Woody Marine

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu EDP
products.description:
Acqua Di Giò Absolu by Giorgio Armani – Eau De Parfum

Product Description

Celebrate the striking alliance between man and nature with Acqua Di Giò Absolu. This powerful and sophisticated creation redefines classic masculinity by fusing the crisp energy of water with the sensual warmth of wood. Housed in a clear bottle that showcases its luminous, amber-colored liquid and crowned with a sustainable ash wood cap, it is a statement of refined luxury and natural elegance.

The fragrance strikes a masterful balance, opening with a sparkling blend of marine notes, bergamot, and juicy fruits like pear and apple. It transitions into an aromatic, masculine heart of lavender, rosemary, and geranium. The base reveals a warm, magnetic trail of rich patchouli, warm labdanum, and tonka bean, adding a sensual, sweet-woody depth that lingers beautifully on the skin.

Fragrance Profile

  • Top Notes: Marine Notes, Bergamot, Pear, Apple, Grapefruit, Lemon

  • Heart Notes: Lavender, Rosemary, Geranium

  • Base Notes: Woody Notes, Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Amberwood, Labdanum

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Giorgio Armani

  • Concentration: Eau De Parfum (EDP)

  • Formulation: For Men / Pour Homme

  • Scent Family: Woody Aromatic / Woody Aquatic

Designed for the man who commands presence, it offers an elevated, highly concentrated signature that is both sensual and enduring.

The fragrance opens with an immediate, signature burst of marine notes combined with crisp bergamot. The heart introduces a refined, aromatic blend of rosemary, clary sage, and geranium, which seamlessly transitions into a magnetic base of patchouli and olibanum (incense), leaving a remarkably luxurious and smoky trail.

Acqua Di Giò Eau De Toilette by Giorgio Armani – Pour Homme

This iconic fragrance is a perfect harmony of sweet and salty notes, capturing the crisp sea air, warmth of the sun, and richness of the earth. Created for the modern, timeless man, it delivers a fresh, clean, and effortlessly sophisticated aura that makes it a global masterpiece.

The fragrance opens with a brilliant splash of fresh calabrian bergamot, neroli, and green mandarin. This aquatic freshness gracefully blends with a complex heart of jasmine, rosemary, and marine notes, before settling into a warm, masculine base of patchouli, cedarwood, and musk.

Product Specifications

  • Concentration: Eau De Toilette (EDT)

products.title: Tom Ford Black Lacquer 100ML
products.description:
Tom Ford Black Lacquer Eau de Parfum is a recent, critically acclaimed triumph from the high-end Private Blend collection. Hailed as a return to the bold, unapologetically dark, and complex roots that originally put Tom Ford on the fragrance map, it won the prestigious Fragrance Foundation "Fragrance of the Year" (Universal Luxury) award.

It is a deeply avant-garde, "badass" fragrance built around high-tech synthetic innovation paired with ultra-rare natural wood extracts.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody / Dark Avant-Garde

  • Top Notes: Black Ink, Vinyl Accord, Black Pepper, Dark Rum

  • Heart Notes: Makassar Ebony Wood (ScentTrek™), Spicy Elemi Resin, Dark Peony, Apricot

  • Base Notes: Olibanum Essence (Frankincense), Atlas Cedarwood NeoAbsolute™

Profile & Behavior

Black Lacquer is a masterfully executed study in the color black. It opens with an incredibly artistic, striking fusion of glossy vinyl and cold black ink, sharpened by a crackle of black pepper and warm, boozy dark rum. This creates a dimensional, "shimmering" synthetic edge that smells identical to ancient, freshly polished lacquerware or a dark, high-end designer showroom.

Beneath that sleek, avant-garde top surface lies a deep, majestic heart driven by Makassar Ebony wood—a rare Indonesian timber captured via headspace technology to protect the trees, yielding heavy, blackened leather and birch-like facets. A subtle undercurrent of dark peony and velvety apricot cuts through the darkness, keeping the wood radiant. The fragrance ultimately shifts into a mesmerizing, spiritual dry-down of high-grade olibanum (frankincense) incense and resinous cedar.

  • Vibe: Hard-edged, mysterious, profoundly artistic, and fiercely stylish. It is the olfactory equivalent of an immaculate all-black luxury suit or structural leather minimalism.

  • How it Evolves: The opening is edgy, smoky, and loud with that vinyl/ink tension. After a brief period of settling close to the skin, it completely re-emerges over the next hour into an incredibly deep, comforting, and hypnotic resinous-woody trail.

  • Seasonality: A spectacular statement piece tailored for the colder months of Fall and Winter, making it an ultimate accessory for elite evening wear, creative gallery openings, or high-status nightlife.

Curation Note (The 100ML Variant)

Retail Context: When structuring listings or sourcing inventory, keep in mind that Tom Ford initially debuted Black Lacquer in 30ML, 50ML, and 250ML Flacons. The 100ML bottle size joins the lineup as the highly coveted "sweet spot" for dedicated collectors, offering the iconic architectural Private Blend silhouette with the maximum amount of juice before stepping into the ultra-expensive splash flacons.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum is a dark, regal, and fiercely bold masterpiece from the Private Blend collection. Often described as a "grail" fragrance among connoisseurs of heavy, masculine scents, it explores a deeply intoxicating Arabic inspiration: the pairing of precious resinous oud wood with the rich, aromatic smoke of Dokha—a traditional Middle Eastern tobacco blended with herbs, flowers, and spices.

Because of its highly polarizing, unapologetic profile, it was pulled from mainstream US retail distribution over recent years, making it an incredibly high-value, rare find for collectors.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Woody Spicy / Tobacco Amber

  • Top Note: Smooth, Boozy Whiskey

  • Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Coriander, Rich Spicy Notes

  • Base Notes: Dark Tobacco Smoke (Dokha Accord), Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Benzoin, Earthy Cedar, Madagascar Vanilla

Profile & Behavior

Tobacco Oud does not hold back. It opens with a stunning, sharp pour of boozy whiskey backed by a dry, crackling blend of warm cinnamon and coriander. This intense, high-end opening immediately sets a commanding, hyper-masculine tone.

As the booze softens, the true core emerges: a deep, realistic tobacco smoke intertwined with a dark, resinous agarwood (oud) accord. Unlike the sweet, honeyed cherry-tobacco found in Tobacco Vanille, the tobacco here is dry, raw, and unburnt—resembling high-grade pipe tobacco or a freshly opened cigar box. Enveloped in smoldering incense, patchouli, and a subtle touch of warm vanilla resin, the dry-down is exceptionally smoky, woody, and wealthy.

  • Vibe: Alpha, commanding, intensely rugged, and deeply sophisticated. It is the scent profile of an exclusive, wood-paneled lounge.

  • Tobacco Vanille vs. Tobacco Oud: While Tobacco Vanille is sweet, creamy, and heavily dominated by vanilla and dried fruits, Tobacco Oud is dry, smoky, animalic, and sharply wood-focused with zero excessive sweetness.

  • Seasonality & Performance: A massive powerhouse built exclusively for the Autumn and Winter cold. It possesses incredible, near-eternal longevity and leaves a powerful, commanding scent trail (sillage) that demands respect.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Tom Ford Noir Eau de Parfum represents the ultimate olfactory portrait of dual personality: the refined, urbane gentleman that the world sees, contrasted with the raw, untamed sensuality that lies beneath the surface. This elegant, dark, and complex oriental fragrance is a masterclass in classic European perfumery, tailor-made for those who command respect with an aura of mystery.

Product Description

An enigmatic, dark, and deeply artistic fragrance, Tom Ford Noir Eau de Parfum opens with a dry, sophisticated tapestry of exotic spices—pink pepper and caraway—seamlessly woven with elegant Italian bergamot. The heart reveals a velvety, deeply masculine floral structure dominated by precious Tuscan iris resin, powdery violet, and black pepper.

As the fragrance settles, it descends into an intoxicating, warm undercurrent. Rich amber, Indonesian patchouli, and sweet Madagascar vanilla are wrapped in a sophisticated leather accord, creating an addictive, magnetic trail that stays exceptionally close to the skin. It is the olfactory equivalent of a bespoke tuxedo or a sleek woolen overcoat—suave, intellectual, and unforgettable.

Olfactory Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody / Powdery Oriental

  • Top Notes: Powdery Violet, Italian Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Caraway

  • Heart Notes: Tuscan Iris Resin, Bulgarian Rose, Black Pepper, Nutmeg, Geranium

  • Base Notes: Rich Amber, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Madagascar Vanilla, Leather, Civet

products.title: Tom Ford Noir EDP
products.description:
Tom Ford Noir Eau de Parfum is an enigmatic, dark, and deeply artistic fragrance from the Signature Collection. Released in 2012, this is the original foundation of the Noir line.

While its famous flanker (Noir Extreme) explores sweet, creamy dessert-like gourmand notes, the original Noir EDP is a masterclass in classic European perfumery—often described as a modern, masculine interpretation of a rich, powdery oriental structure. It is complex, formal, and unapologetically sophisticated.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody / Powdery Oriental

  • Top Notes: Powdery Violet, Italian Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Caraway, Verbena

  • Heart Notes: Tuscan Iris Resin, Bulgarian Rose, Black Pepper, Nutmeg, Geranium, Clary Sage

  • Base Notes: Rich Amber, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Madagascar Vanilla, Leather, Civet, Benzoin, Opoponax

Profile & Behavior

Noir EDP is built beautifully around a concept of duality—capturing the contrast between a refined, perfectly tailored outer appearance and a wild, carnal sensuality beneath.

It opens with an interesting, dry crackle of pink pepper and caraway, rapidly met by an elegant, dark violet flower and a velvety heart of precious Tuscan iris resin and rose. The dry-down is where the true "Noir" character shines: a rich, dense blend of warm amber, earthy patchouli, and heavy resins wrapped in vanilla and leather, accented by a subtle vintage animalic touch that keeps the scent incredibly magnetic.

  • Vibe: Dapper, gothic, intellectual, and deeply mysterious. It is the scent of a sleek woolen overcoat or a bespoke tuxedo.

  • Noir EDP vs. Noir Extreme: While Noir Extreme is highly sweet, mass-appealing, and heavy on edible kulfi/cardamom, the original Noir EDP is drier, more complex, and heavily centered on elegant, upscale powder and dark resins.

  • Seasonality & Wear: This is strictly an evening or cold-weather heavy hitter. It performs exceptionally well in Autumn and Winter, making it an impeccable choice for black-tie events, upscale dinners, or anytime you want to command an atmosphere with an aura of quiet power.

products.title: Tom Ford Eau D'Ombré Leather EDP
products.description:
A quick but important detail to clear up first: while the original Ombré Leather is an Eau de Parfum (EDP), this newer variant—Tom Ford Eau d'Ombré Leather—is actually explicitly released as an Eau de Toilette (EDT).

Don't let the "EDT" label fool you, though. This is not a weak or watered-down version. Instead, it is a brilliant, highly addictive, and smoother twist on the original DNA that infuses a heavy dose of rich vanilla and fresh spices into the classic black leather background. It frequently draws comparisons in the fragrance world to high-end niche vanilla-leathers like YSL Babycat.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Leather / Spicy Oriental

  • Top Notes: Fresh Ginger, Coriander, Cardamom

  • Heart Notes: Glowing Black Leather Accord, Rich Vanilla Tincture

  • Base Notes: Ambrofix™, Benzoin Resinoid, Honeyed Woods

Profile & Behavior

While the original EDP opens with a very direct, photorealistic punch of raw car leather and jasmine, Eau d'Ombré Leather starts with an airy, bright crackle of fresh ginger and coriander. It feels much more radiant and luminous right out of the bottle.

The true magic happens as it warms up. The composition blends a smoother, milder leather accord directly with a luxurious, slightly boozy vanilla tincture and warm benzoin resins. Instead of a rugged cowboy vibe, it creates an ultra-sleek, comforting, and almost creamy texture—resembling a high-end amber-vanilla scent layered with a supple, premium suede jacket.

  • Vibe: Magnetic, cozy, upscale, and effortlessly sensual.

  • Versatility: Highly superior versatility compared to the heavy original. The added sweetness and airy spices make it an absolute banger for casual daily wear, professional settings, and cozy date nights across Fall, Winter, and Spring.

  • Performance: Exceptional for an EDT concentration. It pushes a beautiful, alluring sillage (scent trail) during the first few hours and easily locks onto skin for a solid 7 to 9 hours, settling into a gorgeous vanilla-amber skin scent.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Tom Ford Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum is widely considered one of the greatest leather fragrances ever created. It delivers the ultra-premium, cinematic sensory experience of raw, supple luxury leather wrapped in warm spices and rich florals. Unlike harsh, animalic, or old-school leather scents, Ombré Leather is incredibly smooth, sleek, and approachable—smelling like the interior of a brand-new luxury sports car or a custom-tailored designer jacket.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Warm Leather / Woody Floral

  • Top Note: Cardamom

  • Heart Notes: Black Leather, Jasmine Sambac

  • Base Notes: Amber, Moss, Patchouli

Profile & Behavior

Ombré Leather opens with a clean, instantly captivating crackle of spicy cardamom. This warm, slightly sweet spice paves the way for the star of the show: a massive, photorealistic black leather accord. The leather note here is impeccably clean, smooth, and texturized.

What prevents the fragrance from feeling too rugged or heavy is a brilliant stroke of genius in the heart: Jasmine Sambac. The inclusion of this rich, creamy white floral injects a subtle, breezy sweetness that beautifully softens the leather's edges. As it breathes on the skin, it settles into a wealthy, earthier bed of warm amber, clean patchouli, and green moss, leaving an incredibly sophisticated and addictive trail.

  • Vibe: Bold, independent, ruggedly handsome, and effortlessly stylish.

  • Seasonality & Wear: An absolute powerhouse for Fall, Winter, and cool Spring evenings. It is the ultimate accessory for a black leather jacket, sharp evening wear, or anytime you want to project an air of undeniable confidence and status.

  • Performance: Exceptional. It boasts outstanding longevity and projects a dense, rich scent bubble that commands attention without overpowering a room.

products.title: Tom Ford Rose Exposed EDP
products.description:
While Tom Ford is famous for his incredible rose creations—most notably the sharp and spicy Rose Prick, along with the discontinued classics from the Private Blend Garden Trilogy (Rose de Chine, Rose d'Amalfi, and Rose de Russie)—there is actually no official release named "Rose Exposed" in the Tom Ford lineup.

It is very likely a confusingly close name to a niche fragrance from another luxury house, a temporary working title leaked in the fragrance community, or a typo for one of his actual iconic rose flankers.

Here are the premium Tom Ford rose fragrances you might actually be thinking of:

1. Tom Ford Rose Prick EDP (The Iconic Pink Bottle)

  • The Vibe: Sharp, fashionable, and provocative.

  • The Scent: Built around a triple threat of May, Bulgarian, and Turkish roses, but spiked with Sichuan pepper and turmeric to give it a sharp, "thorny" opening before settling into a warm patchouli and tonka bean base.

2. Tom Ford Cafe Rose (Signature Collection)

  • The Vibe: Dark, sultry, and mysterious.

  • The Scent: A beautiful, dark juxtaposition where elegant Turkish and Bulgarian roses are steeped in a rich, bitter accord of dark coffee, patchouli, and warm resins.

3. Tom Ford Rose de Chine (Private Blend)

  • The Vibe: Exotic, vibrant, and oriental.

  • The Scent: An unexpected, contrast-heavy fragrance that pairs a gorgeous, fresh rose note with the smoky, golden warmth of Chinese peonies and rich myrrh.

Tip: If you are looking for a specific rose fragrance to add to your luxury curation or storefront, Rose Prick and Cafe Rose are the undisputed crowd-pleasers with massive brand recognition.

products.title: Tom Ford Soleil Neige EDP
products.description:
Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum is a brilliant, crystalline masterpiece from the high-end Private Blend collection. Designed to capture the serene, pristine radiance of winter sunlight reflecting off fresh alpine snow ("sun on snow"), this fragrance is a stark, icy contrast to the warm, beachy coconut notes of its sister scent, Soleil Blanc. It delivers an ultra-premium, crisp, and shimmering fresh profile.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Fresh Citrus Floral / Solar Musk

  • Top Notes: Bergamot, Carrot Seeds (creates a unique, icy-crisp, and metallic-fresh opening)

  • Heart Notes: Jasmine Grandiflorum, Orange Blossom, White Flowers, Turkish Rose

  • Base Notes: Benzoin Resins, Madagascar Vanilla, Creamy Skin Musk

Profile & Behavior

Soleil Neige opens with an immediate, sparkling flash of bergamot paired with a highly distinctive carrot seed note. This unique combination strips away any traditional juicy warmth, creating a texture that feels freezing, airy, and brilliantly bright—mimicking the crisp bite of fresh mountain air.

As the fragrance warms on the skin, it evolves into a wealthy, radiant heart of orange blossom and jasmine. Rather than feeling heavy or tropical, these white florals are executed with a clean, watercolor sheerness. The dry-down settles into an incredibly smooth, comforting base of creamy musk and warm benzoin resin infused with a touch of vanilla, beautifully replicating the soft, golden warmth of a winter sun setting over glacial peaks.

  • Vibe: Pristine, ethereal, impeccably clean, and effortlessly wealthy.

  • Versatility: Exceptional as an upscale daytime signature. It shines beautifully during cold, crisp Winter and Spring days, yet its bright, airy floral-musk backbone makes it an incredibly sophisticated, non-cloying option for Summer heat.

  • Presentation: Housed in the architectural Private Blend bottle, executed in an elegant, glossy milk-white finish with gleaming silver accents that perfectly mirror the pure, icy, and high-status nature of the juice inside.

products.title: Tom Ford Jasmin Rouge EDP
products.description:
Tom Ford Jasmin Rouge Eau de Parfum is an opulent, unapologetically theatrical floral masterpiece from the high-end Private Blend collection. It explores the deeply seductive, carnal, and spicy facets of jasmine, shifting the flower away from its usual innocent, clean profile. Infused with rich spices and precious resins, it is a voluptuous, high-status fragrance that embodies old-Hollywood glamour.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Floral Amber / Spicy White Floral

  • Top Notes: Cinnamon, Ginger, Cardamom, Black and White Pepper, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot

  • Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Ylang-Ylang, Neroli, Broom, Clary Sage

  • Base Notes: Amber, French Labdanum, Vanilla, Leather, Woody Notes

Profile & Behavior

Jasmin Rouge opens with a dazzling, exotic burst of hot cinnamon, sharp ginger, and green cardamom. This heavy spice blend instantly warms up the composition, preventing the upcoming florals from feeling cold or soapy.

The heart belongs to an exceptionally high-quality Jasmine Sambac absolute. It is dense, honeyed, and intensely rich, amplified by the creamy, tropical warmth of ylang-ylang. As the fragrance matures on the skin, it sinks into a wealthy, golden base of molten amber, smooth vanilla, and a highly sophisticated trace of leather. The dry-down feels incredibly velvety, warm, and deeply carnal.

  • Vibe: Sultry, sophisticated, dramatic, and captivating.

  • Seasonality & Performance: While the white florals make it beautiful for upscale Spring evenings, its heavy spice and amber foundation allow it to cut through the Autumn and Winter cold beautifully. It projects an intoxicating, magnetic scent trail (sillage) with stellar longevity.

  • Presentation: Housed in the architectural Private Blend bottle, executed in a striking, deep translucent ruby-red glass that perfectly reflects the bold, passionate, and rouge character of the juice inside.

products.title: Tom Ford Rose Prick EDP
products.description:
Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum is a sharp, stunningly beautiful floral masterpiece from the high-end Private Blend collection. Inspired by Tom Ford’s private rose garden, this fragrance is designed around the concept of a "rose with thorns"—juxtaposing a pristine, luxurious bouquet of rare roses with a sharp, biting crackle of wild spices and earthy patchouli.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Warm Floral / Spicy Rose

  • Top Notes: Sichuan Pepper, Turmeric (creates a sharp, prickly, and exotic opening)

  • Heart Notes: May Rose (Rose de Mai), Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose

  • Base Notes: Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Tolu Balsam, Musk

Profile & Behavior

Rose Prick shatters the stereotype of traditional, powdery grandmotherly roses. It opens with an immediate, unexpected prickle of Sichuan pepper and earthy turmeric. This creates a vibrant, slightly dry heat that beautifully mimics the sharp sting of a rose thorn.

Once the spices soften, the heart unfolds into an ultra-premium, dense trilogy of the world’s finest roses: May, Bulgarian, and Turkish roses. This triple-rose blend smells wealthy, full-bodied, and incredibly fresh. The fragrance settles into a smooth, dark base of clean patchouli and warm, sweet tonka bean, giving the dry-down a seductive, skin-like depth that lasts for hours.

  • Vibe: Provocative, fashionable, high-status, and sharply elegant.

  • Seasonality & Wear: An exceptional transitional scent that performs beautifully in Spring, Fall, and Winter. It carries an upscale, editorial presence that makes it a spectacular choice for fine dining, high-end events, or as a commanding daily signature scent.

  • Presentation: Housed in an instantly recognizable architectural bottle executed in an opaque, matte baby-pink finish, beautifully contrasting the dark, thorny complexity of the juice inside.

products.title: Tom Ford Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Tom Ford Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum ("Smoked Ebony") is a deeply spiritual, meditative masterpiece from the high-end Private Blend collection. It captures the ancient, purifying ritual of Palo Santo, balancing the raw, crackling energy of burning wood with the sleek, polished luxury of premium resins and ebony. It is a dark, warm, and highly intoxicating scent for connoisseurs of woody fragrances.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Woody Amber / Aromatic Incense

  • Top Notes: Palo Santo Wood Smoke, Incense, Black Pepper, Violet Leaf

  • Heart Notes: Rich Leather, Labdanum, Cade Oil, Papyrus, Rose Neo Absolute

  • Base Notes: African Ebony Wood, Guaiac Wood, Resinous Benzoin

Profile & Behavior

Ébène Fumé opens with an immediate, striking blast of authentic Palo Santo smoke and resinous incense, sharpened by a pinch of black pepper. Unlike synthetic, harsh smoky scents, this opening is remarkably smooth, mystical, and instantly calming.

As the initial smoke settles, a sleek leather accord and rich labdanum emerge in the heart, creating a wealthy, textural transition. The true backbone of the fragrance is the African ebony wood in the base—a dark, dense, and regal wood note that is enveloped by warm, slightly sweet benzoin resins. The dry-down leaves a sophisticated, warm, and balsamic trail on the skin that feels incredibly expensive.

  • Vibe: Mystical, commanding, artistic, and deeply luxurious.

  • Seasonality: The ultimate cold-weather statement piece. It shines beautifully in Fall and Winter, serving as an exceptional signature for upscale evening wear, formal gatherings, or anytime you want to project an air of quiet power and mystery.

  • Performance: Densely layered with fantastic longevity. It creates a rich, warm, and highly inviting personal scent bubble that stays close to the wearer while commanding attention from anyone nearby.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir Extreme  EDP
products.description:
Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum is a modern classic in the realm of gourmand fragrances. It represents the olfactory profile of a man who relishes immoderation and dares to be extraordinary.

By combining sharp, exotic spices with an incredibly unique, creamy Indian dessert accord, it strikes a flawless balance between rugged masculinity and edible, sweet sophistication.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody Gourmand

  • Top Notes: Cardamom, Nutmeg, Saffron, Mandarin Orange, Neroli

  • Heart Notes: Kulfi Accord, Rose, Jasmine, Orange Blossom

  • Base Notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Amber, Woody Notes, Sandalwood

Profile & Behavior

Noir Extreme opens with an immediate, upscale crackle of cardamom and saffron, brightened gently by a splash of mandarin. However, the true signature of this fragrance lies in its heart: the Kulfi accord. Inspired by the traditional Indian frozen dessert, this note brings a rich, dense, and milky sweetness inflected with pistachios and rosewater.

As it evolves into the dry-down, the dessert quality settles into a thick, comforting bed of warm amber and smooth Madagascar vanilla. It remains woody enough in the background to ensure the composition feels mature, dark, and deeply seductive rather than overly youthful or sugary.

  • Vibe: Suave, enigmatic, wealthy, and unapologetically sensual.

  • Seasonality: The ultimate cool-weather heavy hitter. It shines spectacularly in late Autumn and Winter, making it a legendary option for date nights, formal evening events, or holiday gatherings.

  • Performance: It creates a rich, intoxicating scent bubble that projects beautifully without becoming cloying, boasting fantastic longevity that lingers on skin and clothing for hours.

products.title: Tom Ford Soleil De Feu EDP
products.description:
Tom Ford Soleil de Feu Eau de Parfum is a captivating, bronze-hued addition to the celebrated Soleil collection within Tom Ford's Private Blend line. Inspired by the warmth of a blazing sunset over the sea, this fragrance trades the breezy, beachy, and solar-coconut vibes of its predecessors (like Soleil Blanc) for a deeply rich, smoky, and sensual amber-woody architecture.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody Floral

  • Key Notes: Molten Amber, Smoked Sandalwood, Tuberose, Benzoin Resins

Profile & Behavior

Soleil de Feu acts like a bridge between a brilliant summer day and a dark, sultry winter evening. It opens with an immediate, opulent wave of molten amber that feels thick, warm, and golden.

Unlike other summer-themed scents, the heart introduces a velvety, upscale tuberose that is stripped of its traditional green or bubblegum sweetness, serving instead to add a creamy, carnal floral layer. The composition is anchored by a dense, slightly smoky sandalwood and resinous benzoin, leaving a dry-down that feels deeply comforting, smooth, and incredibly high-end.

  • Vibe: Sun-warmed, passionate, opulent, and fiercely seductive.

  • Seasonality & Wear: Extremely versatile across seasons. It has enough warmth and woodiness to cut through the autumn and winter cold, yet carries an unmistakable "sun-baked skin" signature that makes it an alluring option for upscale summer nights.

  • Presentation: Housed in the architectural Private Blend bottle, executed in an elegant, milky-white translucent glass with gold accents that beautifully mirrors the premium, clean-yet-warm nature of the juice inside.

products.title: Tom Ford Soleil Blanc Perfume EDP
products.description:
Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif is the ultra-premium crowning achievement of the legendary Bleu de Chanel collection. Released in late 2025, this composition marks the most sophisticated, darkest, and most luxurious evolution of the franchise.

Crafted by Chanel's in-house master perfumer Olivier Polge, it is designed like an Extrait de Parfum—stripping away much of the athletic, day-wear aquatic freshness of the earlier formulations to deliver an opulent, resinous, and deeply warm masterpiece.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Intense Woody Amber / Cuir-Aromatic

  • Top Notes: Crystallized Citrus Flash, Crisp Cold Aromatics

  • Heart Notes: Magnetic Cedarwood, Rich Cistus Labdanum, Soft Smoked Leather

  • Base Notes: Precious New Caledonian Sandalwood, Deep Amberwood, Soft Incense

Profile & Performance

While it keeps a brilliant, fleeting trace of the iconic "Bleu" clean citrus signature in its initial opening seconds, L'Exclusif rapidly transitions into an entirely new territory for the line.

The heart and base push a powerful, high-concentration dose of precious New Caledonian Sandalwood to the forefront, giving the juice a magnificent, buttery-smooth woodiness. This is wrapped in the dark, mysterious warmth of cistus labdanum and a tailored leather accord that feels incredibly suave rather than heavy or animalic. A faint trail of sweet, resinous amber and soft incense ensures it clings magnetically to the skin.

  • The Vibe: High-status, mysterious, opulent, and commandingly formal.

  • Versatility & Seasonality: Tailor-made for cold weather, evening events, executive wear, and special occasions where you want to project undeniable elegance. It is significantly more complex and "niche-leaning" than the standard line.

  • Presentation: Chanel completely re-engineered the presentation for this elite release. The juice is housed in a bold, heavy, cubic geometric block bottle with thickened glass that catches light in a striking dark navy-to-black gradient.

products.title: Bleu De Chanel Paris L'Exclusif Parfum

Crafted by Chanel's in-house master perfumer Olivier Polge, it is designed like an Extrait de Parfum—stripping away much of the athletic, day-wear aquatic freshness of the earlier formulations to deliver an opulent, resinous, and deeply warm masterpiece.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Intense Woody Amber / Cuir-Aromatic

  • Top Notes: Crystallized Citrus Flash, Crisp Cold Aromatics

  • Heart Notes: Magnetic Cedarwood, Rich Cistus Labdanum, Soft Smoked Leather

  • Base Notes: Precious New Caledonian Sandalwood, Deep Amberwood, Soft Incense

Profile & Performance

While it keeps a brilliant, fleeting trace of the iconic "Bleu" clean citrus signature in its initial opening seconds, L'Exclusif rapidly transitions into an entirely new territory for the line.

The heart and base push a powerful, high-concentration dose of precious New Caledonian Sandalwood to the forefront, giving the juice a magnificent, buttery-smooth woodiness. This is wrapped in the dark, mysterious warmth of cistus labdanum and a tailored leather accord that feels incredibly suave rather than heavy or animalic. A faint trail of sweet, resinous amber and soft incense ensures it clings magnetically to the skin.

  • The Vibe: High-status, mysterious, opulent, and commandingly formal.

  • Versatility & Seasonality: Tailor-made for cold weather, evening events, executive wear, and special occasions where you want to project undeniable elegance. It is significantly more complex and "niche-leaning" than the standard line.

  • Presentation: Chanel completely re-engineered the presentation for this elite release. The juice is housed in a bold, heavy, cubic geometric block bottle with thickened glass that catches light in a striking dark navy-to-black gradient.

products.title: Bleu de Chanel Parfum
products.description:
Bleu de Chanel Parfum is the most concentrated, richest, and deepest iteration in the legendary Bleu de Chanel trilogy. Released in 2018 and crafted by in-house master perfumer Olivier Polge, this version shifts the franchise's identity away from the sharp, athletic freshness of the original Eau de Toilette (EDT) and pushes it into an ultra-premium, dark, and sophisticated woody-creamy masterpiece.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Woody Aromatic

  • Top Notes: Zesty Lemon Peel, Bergamot, Fresh Mint, Artemisia

  • Heart Notes: Crisp Lavender, Pineapple, Geranium, Green Notes

  • Base Notes: New Caledonian Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Amberwood, Tonka Bean, Iso E Super

Profile & Performance

While it retains the unmistakable "blue" freshness that made the line famous, the Parfum variant trades sharp grapefruit and synthetic incenses for a remarkably smooth lemon peel and aromatic opening.

The undisputed star of the dry-down is a generous dose of precious New Caledonian Sandalwood. This rare ingredient gives the Parfum a velvety, rich, and almost buttery woodiness that feels incredibly smooth on the skin. Supported by clean cedar and a touch of sweet tonka bean, it feels densely layered, dark, and highly elegant.

  • Vibe: Commandingly masculine, mature, wealthy, and flawlessly tailored.

  • Versatility: The absolute king of versatility, though it leans slightly more formal than the EDT and EDP versions. It is an impeccable choice for a signature daily scent, executive boardrooms, upscale dinners, and intimate evenings.

  • Performance: Exceptional. Because of its higher oil concentration, it sits closer to the skin but lasts for an incredible length of time (frequently greater than 10 hours), leaving a rich, sophisticated trail that radiates warmth whenever someone gets close to you.

  • Visual Distinction: It is housed in the iconic, minimalist navy block bottle, but it is immediately distinguished by its striking gold-foil lettering for the brand and the word PARFUM at the base.

products.title: Chanel Allure Homme Édition Blanche Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Chanel Allure Homme Édition Blanche Eau de Parfum is a widely celebrated, luxury masterpiece renowned for its brilliant "hot-and-cold" olfactory contrast. Composed by master perfumer Jacques Polge, this fragrance is frequently described by the fragrance community as the ultimate luxury lemon meringue pie in a bottle—balancing razor-sharp, photorealistic citrus with a wealthy, creamy, and sophisticated gourmand base.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Fresh Citrus Oriental / Woody Amber

  • Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Calabrian Bergamot

  • Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Haitian Vetiver, Ginger

  • Base Notes: Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, White Musk

Profile & Behavior

Édition Blanche opens with a spectacular explosion of Sicilian lemon and bergamot that is completely free of any synthetic "cleaning product" harshness; it smells incredibly natural, bright, and effervescent.

As the sharp citrus begins to settle, the composition undergoes a beautiful transformation. The introduction of creamy sandalwood and a smooth combination of Madagascar vanilla and tonka bean rounds out the edges. This creates a highly addictive texture where the bright, sour energy of the lemon sits perfectly on top of a warm, rich, and velvety base. A subtle crackle of ginger and a touch of clean vetiver ensure the scent remains distinctly masculine and sophisticated throughout.

  • Vibe: Impeccably groomed, upscale, sunny, and effortlessly refined.

  • Versatility: This is the ultimate high-end warm-weather signature. It shines brilliantly in Spring and Summer, serving as an exceptional choice for the office, luxury resort wear, daytime dates, or casual afternoons when you want to project a high-status aura.

  • Performance: The EDP concentration provides solid longevity on the skin, leaving a gentle, highly inviting scent bubble that draws people closer rather than overpowering a room.

products.title: Chanel Allure Homme Sport Superleggera EDP
products.description:
Chanel Allure Homme Sport Superleggera Eau de Parfum is a premium, limited-edition release from the house of Chanel. Crafted by in-house perfumer Olivier Polge, the fragrance takes its name from the famous Italian automotive term Superleggera ("super-light")—referencing the historic technique of wrapping a lightweight aluminum body over a structural frame.

True to its concept, this flanker re-engineers the classic Allure Homme Sport DNA by stripping away the heavy, creamy vanilla facets and replacing them with a lighter, highly precise, and revitalized woody-musky core.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Woody Aromatic Citrus

  • Top Notes: Crisp Grapefruit Accord, Sparkling Mandarin, Bright Citrus Zest

  • Heart Notes: Light Cedarwood, Vibrant Dynamic Woods

  • Base Notes: Clean Patchouli (the "engine" of the scent), Luxurious White Musk, Smooth Sandalwood, Warm Amber

Profile & Performance

Superleggera opens with an immediate, high-concentration blast of grapefruit and mandarin that carries an almost metallic, razor-sharp zing. Olivier Polge rebalanced the traditional mid-notes by dialing up a clean, airy cedarwood and introducing a very specific, purified patchouli note that is entirely absent from the original formulation.

The dry-down pulls away from the dense, powdery sweetness of Eau Extrême, instead settling into an incredibly sophisticated, sporty blend of velvety sandalwood and a dominant, skin-like white musk.

  • Vibe: Sleek, aerodynamic, modern, and effortlessly polished.

  • Character: It trades the warm, evening-ready weight of its predecessors for a more athletic, casual, and free-spirited daytime feel.

  • Versatility: An absolute powerhouse for daily wear, high-end office environments, warm summer days, and active settings where you want to smell impeccably clean without overpowering a room.

products.title: Chanel Allure Homme Sport Eau Extreme
products.description:
Chanel Allure Homme Sport Eau Extrême is an undisputed titan in modern masculine perfumery. Crafted by master perfumer Jacques Polge and launched in 2012, this flanker takes the refreshing, athletic DNA of the original Allure Homme Sport and pushes it into a deeper, highly addictive, and intensely sensual territory. It is celebrated worldwide for its incredible versatility and massive crowd appeal.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Aromatic Woody Amber

  • Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Mint, Cypress, Clary Sage

  • Heart Notes: Sharp Black Pepper

  • Base Notes: Venezuelan Tonka Bean, White Musk, Sandalwood, Cedar

Profile & Performance

Allure Homme Sport Eau Extrême behaves like a fragrance of two halves. It opens with an immediate, energizing blast of tart mandarin and ice-cold mint, backed by a clean, green cypress note that gives it a bracing, athletic edge.

As it settles, the fragrance shifts beautifully into its signature dry-down. A heavy dose of creamy, bittersweet Tonka bean and luxurious white musk takes over, enveloping the initial freshness in a smooth, warm, and borderline powdery sweetness. This interplay between cold mint and warm tonka bean gives it a magnetic quality.

  • Vibe: Sophisticated, athletic, seductive, and effortlessly confident.

  • Versatility: Exceptional. It is one of the ultimate "anytime, anywhere" fragrances. It functions perfectly as a casual daytime scent, a post-workout refresher, a commanding office fragrance, or a captivating date-night projector.

  • Performance: Outstanding longevity and strong, room-filling projection (sillage). It cuts through cold air beautifully while remaining smooth enough not to choke anyone out in the summer heat.

products.title: Chanel N°1 De Chanel L'eau Rouge EDP
products.description:
N°1 de Chanel L'Eau Rouge is a revitalizing fragrance mist that anchors Chanel's eco-responsible, clean beauty line. Formulated by Chanel's In-House Perfumer Olivier Polge, this unique composition acts as both a delicate fragrance and a skincare-infused body spray. It uses a base of red camellia extract and camellia water to refresh and energize the senses.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Fruity Floral Aromatic

  • Top Notes: Red Berries, Citrus Accord (Sparkling Mandarin and Orange)

  • Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rose, Orange Blossom

  • Base Notes: Comforting Musks, Iris

Profile & Performance

Unlike traditional Chanel heavyweights, L'Eau Rouge is incredibly ethereal, airy, and translucent. It opens with an energizing splash of tart red berries and crisp citrus. The heart unfolds into Chanel's signature rose and jasmine bouquet, but executed with a watercolor-like sheerness. The dry-down settles into a soft, powdery, skin-like musk and iris veil.

  • The Formulation: Strictly speaking, this is a Revitalizing Fragrance Mist (Eau Parfumée) rather than a concentrated Eau de Parfum (EDP). It features a skincare component, designed to be sprayed generously over the hair, face, and body for an instant burst of hydration and light scent.

  • Vibe: Fresh, clean, rejuvenating, and radiant.

  • Sustainability & Design: The striking, minimalist deep red glass bottle is constructed with lighter-weight glass and features a bio-resin cap, aligning with the line's strict eco-conscious standards.

products.title: Chanel Coco Mademoiselle L'Eau Privée night fragrance
products.description:
Chanel Coco Mademoiselle L'Eau Privée is a soft, intimate interpretation of the iconic original, specifically formulated as a "night fragrance" (Parfum pour la Nuit). Created by Chanel’s In-House Perfumer Creator Olivier Polge, this flanker is designed to be worn like a delicate veil before going to bed or for elegant lounging, trading the assertive punch of the original for an enveloping, whisper-soft sensuality.

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Soft Floral Amber

  • Top Notes: Fresh, Muted Mandarin Orange

  • Heart Notes: Soft Rose Petals, Absolute of Jasmine

  • Base Notes: Delicate White Musk, Fluid Wood Notes

Profile & Nighttime Formulation

L'Eau Privée intentionally scales back the sharp, polarizing elements of the classic Coco Mademoiselle DNA. The vibrant, sparkling citrus is dialed down to a comforting, watercolor mandarin, while the heavy, sharp patchouli backbone is replaced by a fluid, clean white musk.

The result is a faint, powdery, and incredibly smooth skin-scent that feels comforting rather than loud. It is structurally lighter so that it gently lingers on sheets, pajamas, and skin without overpowering the senses as you drift off to sleep.

  • Vibe: Intimate, cozy, effortlessly elegant, and private.

  • Versatility: Designed exclusively for nighttime routines, post-bath relaxation, intimate evenings at home, or anytime you want a comforting, non-intrusive personal scent.

  • Presentation: Housed in a gorgeous, frosted glass version of the iconic bottle, hinting at the softer, dreamier juice inside.

products.title: COCO MADEMOISELLE EDP
products.description:
Chanel Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum is a global icon and a definitive masterpiece of modern perfumery. Launched in 2001 and composed by master perfumer Jacques Polge, it completely reinvented the "neo-chypre" genre. It captures an effortlessly chic, spirited, and independent feminine character by balancing vibrant citrus with a deeply sophisticated, clean patchouli backbone.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Floral / Neo-Chypre

  • Top Notes: Vibrant Orange, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange

  • Heart Notes: Grasse Rose, Italian Jasmine, Mimosa

  • Base Notes: Fractionated Clean Patchouli, Haitian Vetiver, Bourbon Vanilla, White Musk

Profile & Performance

Coco Mademoiselle opens with an immediate, sparkling flash of vibrant citrus that feels incredibly airy and bright. As the top notes settle, a refined heart of rose and jasmine emerges.

What gives this fragrance its legendary signature is the base: Chanel utilizes a highly purified, fractionated patchouli that strips away any heavy, earthy dampness, leaving behind a clean, woody, and borderline sparkling texture. Complemented by smooth white musk and a touch of vanilla, it leaves an unforgettable, intoxicating scent trail.

  • Vibe: Sophisticated, bold, elegant, and timelessly luxurious.

  • Versatility: Unmatched. It is legendary for its adaptability—assertive enough for executive meetings, sparkling enough for casual days, and alluring enough for formal evenings.

  • Performance: Exceptional longevity and strong projection. It stays vibrant on skin for hours and leaves a memorable presence in any room.

products.title: Louis Vuitton L'Immensité Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Louis Vuitton L’Immensité Eau de Parfum is a masterclass in modern, ultra-premium fresh fragrances. Crafted by master perfumer Jacques Cavallier Belletrud, it captures the feeling of standing before an infinite horizon. It seamlessly blends the crisp freshness of a sharp citrus-ginger opening with the sensual, skin-like warmth of amber and woods.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Spicy Citrus

  • Top Notes: Bitter Grapefruit, Zesty Ginger, Calabrian Bergamot

  • Heart Notes: Rosemary, Sage, Geranium (adds a clean, aromatic texture)

  • Base Notes: Ambroxan, Labdanum, Amber

Profile & Behavior

L’Immensité opens with an incredibly realistic, sharp grapefruit note backed by a spicy crackle of fresh ginger. What sets it apart from typical freshies is its heavy use of Ambroxan and ambergris-like notes in the base. As it dries down, the bright citrus softens into a highly attractive, metallic-clean, and muscular warmth that clings to skin and fabric for hours.

  • Vibe: Effortlessly luxurious, masculine, clean-cut, and dynamic.

  • Versatility: One of the most versatile high-end scents on the market. It transitions flawlessly from a casual summer afternoon to a high-profile corporate boardroom or formal evening.

  • Performance: Excellent projection and longevity for a fresh profile, radiating an alluring, airy scent trail (sillage) that commands attention.

products.description:
Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum takes the signature floral-amber DNA of the original Paradoxe and dials up the richness. It explores an amplification of strength through delicate ingredients, delivering a deeper, more voluptuous, and noticeably warmer scent profile.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Floral Amber Woody

  • Top Notes: Pear Accord, Bergamot Essence, Neroli Buds

products.title: Prada Paradigme by Prada for Men
products.description:
Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum is a signature masculine fragrance from Prada. Built on a unique concept, the scent utilizes an "inverted olfactory pyramid"—meaning it is built from the bottom up to challenge traditional fragrance architecture.

It balances an initial wave of fresh, airy crispness with a deeply smooth, magnetic resinous warmth in the dry-down.

 

The Scent Breakdown

  • Fragrance Family: Ambery Woody (with a clean, aromatic edge)

  • Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot Heart, Airy Musks

  • Heart Notes: Bourbon Geranium (reinvented with a slightly rosy, green floral facet)

  • Base Notes: Peru Balsam, Benzoin Resin, Guaiac Wood

Character & Performance

Instead of fading immediately into standard woods, Paradigme relies on the density of Peru balsam and benzoin to anchor the composition, giving it an enveloping, slightly sweet warmth that lingers comfortably. The inclusion of bourbon geranium lends a sophisticated, clean, and put-together attitude that keeps it distinctively "Prada" without relying on their classic heavy iris notes.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'homme Eau De Toilette
products.description:
Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau de Toilette

Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau de Toilette is a legendary, deeply sensual, and masterfully understated creation widely celebrated as one of the ultimate date-night and close-quarters fragrances ever engineered. Moving away from typical sharp, loud blue scents or overly heavy winter orientals, La Nuit De L'Homme establishes a brilliant balance of sophisticated spice and creamy warmth. It is designed for the modern gentleman who exudes effortless charm, mystery, and magnetism, leaving an incredibly irresistible and smooth trail.

The fragrance opens with an immediate, main-character blast of premium, aromatic cardamom that delivers a warm, exotic, and spicy introduction. As the bright spice settles, it transitions beautifully into a clean, highly texturized heart dominated by fresh French lavender and crisp Virginia cedarwood, giving the composition a perfectly balanced, sophisticated woody-floral core. The dry-down uncovers a highly addictive, comforting foundation where dark caraway spice is wrapped in the deep, smoky warmth of vetiver and rich coumarin, leaving an exceptionally smooth and comforting signature.

Fragrance Profile
Olfactive Family Woody Spicy / Amber Spicy
Top Notes Cardamom
Heart Notes French Lavender, Virginia Cedar
Base Notes Vetiver, Caraway, Coumarin
Best For Romantic date nights, intimate evening settings, formal gatherings, and autumn or winter wear
Performance Good longevity (6–7 hours) with an alluring, intoxicating, and close-quarters sillage

products.title: YSL Black Opium Over Red EDP
products.description:
Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Over Red Eau de Parfum is an incredibly juicy, seductive, and highly addictive flanker that injects a bold burst of dark fruit into the iconic coffee-gourmand DNA. Stepping away from the pure darkness of the Extreme version and the heavy pear sweetness of the original, Over Red introduces a brilliant, main-character twist of ripe cherry. It is a stunning exploration of contrasts, designed for the modern woman who wants a playful, high-energy signature that transitions beautifully from chic daytime wear into a mesmerizing nightlife accessory.

The fragrance opens with an immediate, mouth-watering explosion of sweet black cherry accord, brightened beautifully by a refreshing squeeze of green mandarin essence. As the initial fruity rush softens, it transitions seamlessly into a highly sophisticated, luminous heart where the signature rich black coffee accord meets an elegant bouquet of clean orange blossom and jasmine grandiflorum. The dry-down uncovers a deeply comforting, sensual foundation where smooth Madagascar vanilla infusion is wrapped in warm, earthy Indonesian patchouli essence, leaving a deliciously unique, velvety trail.

Base Notes Madagascar Vanilla Infusion, Patchouli Essence

products.title: YSL Manifesto EDP
products.description:
Yves Saint Laurent Manifesto Eau de Parfum

Yves Saint Laurent Manifesto Eau de Parfum is an exceptionally bold, sensual, and artistic creation celebrating free-spirited femininity and passionate intuition. Stepping away from overly light, airy florals, Manifesto carves its own lane by introducing a brilliant contrast between crisp green crispness and a dense, creamy, near-gourmand warmth. It is crafted for the sophisticated woman who dictates her own rules, delivering a highly distinctive, luxurious signature that leaves a sophisticated and magnetic trail.

The fragrance opens with an immediate, unexpected contrast—a sharp, refreshing splash of tart black currant and crisp green notes meets the soft brightness of bergamot. As the initial brightness softens, it transitions beautifully into a powdery, elegant heart dominated by clean creamy lily-of-the-valley and sweet jasmine sambac, giving the scent a rich, expensive floral texture. The dry-down uncovers the true masterpiece of the composition, settling into a heavy, highly addictive foundation where sweet Madagascar vanilla and warm tonka bean are wrapped in smooth cedarwood and velvety sandalwood.

Fragrance Profile
Olfactive Family Amber Floral / Woody Vanilla
Top Notes Black Currant, Green Notes, Bergamot
Heart Notes Jasmine Sambac, Lily-of-the-Valley
Base Notes Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Cedarwood
Best For Evening wear, autumn and winter months, upscale events, and romantic date nights

Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum is an ultra-intense, edgy, and deeply hypnotic creation that takes the iconic coffee-gourmand DNA of the original masterpiece to its absolute limit. As the intense opening deepens, it transitions into a luminous yet sophisticated heart where rich Indian jasmine grandiflorum and luminous orange blossom add an expensive, modern floral texture. products.description:
Christian Dior Dune Eau de Toilette is a brilliant, serene, and deeply poetic masterpiece that stands as one of the most unique creations in perfume history. Stepping far away from traditional sweet florals or heavy evening orientals, Dune captures the peaceful essence of an oceanic desert—where rolling sand dunes meet a cool sea breeze. Crafted for the sophisticated woman who appreciates understated luxury, this innovative composition offers an incredibly artistic, comforting, and distinctive signature.

The fragrance opens with an immediate, refreshing burst of zesty mandarin orange, sweet Brazilian rosewood, and clean aldehydes, beautifully balanced by a crisp touch of green notes. As the initial brightness settles, the scent transforms into a warm, sun-drenched heart where powdery amber-colored wallflower and delicate jasmine blend seamlessly with a hint of sea air. The dry-down uncovers a majestic, long-lasting foundation where rich, earthy sandalwood and warm ambergris are wrapped in sweet Madagascar vanilla and mossy oakmoss, leaving a smooth, comforting, and unforgettable trail.

products.title: Passion Dior Edt
products.description:
Christian Dior Poison Eau de Toilette

Christian Dior Poison Eau de Toilette is a legendary, dark, and revolutionary masterpiece that completely redefined modern perfumery upon its historic release. Widely regarded as one of the ultimate fragrance weapons of heightened seduction, it trades typical polite florals for an intoxicating, bombastic contrast of forbidden dark fruits, deep resins, and thick honey. Crafted for the bold, unforgettable woman, this enigmatic composition remains a timeless statement of high-end luxury and magnetic charisma.

The fragrance opens with an immediate, opulent explosion of sweet, succulent dark plum and wild berries, sharpened beautifully by a spicy flash of coriander and star anise. As the dramatic introduction deepens, it transitions into an incredibly rich, multidimensional heart where creamy tuberose absolute and delicate jasmine are wrapped in heavy, sweet white honey and warm cinnamon. The dry-down uncovers an absolute powerhouse foundation where dark incense, velvety opopanax, and warm amber are smoothed out by rich Madagascar vanilla, leaving an unforgettable, room-filling trail.

Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Eau de Toilette Intense is a legendary, high-octane powerhouse that stands as one of the ultimate nightlife and clubbing fragrances ever created. Masterfully updating the original 1995 DNA, Ultra Male amplifies the sweetness and contrast, crafting a hyper-appealing blend of juicy fruit and deep, spicy warmth. As the initial brightness settles, the composition evolves into a warm, tantalizing heart where spicy cumin and cinnamon blend with aromatic clary sage. Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum pushes the iconic gold-bar lineup into an ultra-premium, deeply captivating territory. This formulation is a powerful, sun-drenched interpretation of the original DNA, striking an intoxicating balance between rich, salty leather and radiant floral warmth. Crafted for the man who dares to stand out, it is a statement-making composition designed to leave an unforgettable impression during wild nights and colder seasons.

The fragrance opens with an unexpected, brilliant contrast, blending a rich, salty solar accord with the creamy warmth of monoi oil and sweet tuberose. As the initial brightness settles, the composition evolves into a deeply magnetic heart where smooth, premium leather merges with resinous amber. The dry-down uncovers an absolute powerhouse foundation, wrapping comforting cashmeran wood and rich pine notes around a deeply sensual, long-lasting trail.

Fragrance Profile
Olfactive Family Leather / Solar Amber
Key Notes Salty Accord, Tuberose, Monoi Oil, Leather, Amber, Cashmeran, Pine
Concentration Parfum
Best For Nightclubs, evening wear, fall and winter, and bold expressions
Performance Beast-mode longevity (10+ hours) with a heavy, highly magnetic sillage

products.title: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Mandarin Basilic  for Unisex EDT
products.description:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau de Toilette is a sparkling, effervescent, and deeply uplifting unisex fragrance that celebrates the joyful pairing of juicy citrus and fresh aromatic herbs. As a standout icon within Guerlain’s nature-inspired Aqua Allegoria collection, this light and airy fragrance captures the essence of a sun-drenched Mediterranean garden, offering a sophisticated cleanliness that feels exceptionally bright, natural, and invigorating.

The fragrance opens with an absolute burst of realistic, mouth-watering top notes, blending sweet, juicy mandarin orange and bitter bigarade citrus with the green crispness of clementine, green tea, and ivy. As the initial zest softens, the star combination comes alive in the heart, where the peppery, aromatic freshness of real basil leaves perfectly balances a radiant floral bouquet of peony, chamomile, and orange blossom. The dry-down settles into a soft, comforting base of warm amber and light, sophisticated sandalwood, leaving an elegant, breezy trail on the skin.

Fragrance Profile
Olfactive Family Citrus Aromatic
Top Notes Mandarin Orange, Clementine, Bitter Orange, Green Tea, Ivy
Heart Notes Basil, Peony, Chamomile, Orange Blossom
Base Notes Sandalwood, Amber
Best For Spring and summer, daily signature wear, hot afternoons, and casual luxury
Performance Moderate longevity (4–6 hours) with a radiant, refreshingly crisp sillage
