products.title: Dior Fahrenheit
products.description:
Dior Fahrenheit is a legendary, groundbreaking, and timeless masculine icon that redefined modern men's perfumery. Created by Jean-Louis Sieuzac and Michel Almairac, this legendary fragrance is famous for its unique signature "leather and gasoline" violet leaf accord, seamlessly balancing fiery warmth with crisp freshness.

Opening with a famous, luminous burst of lavender, mandarin orange, nutmeg, hawthorn, and cedar, Fahrenheit immediately commands attention with a fresh yet complex aromatic freshness. The heart settles into its iconic floral-woody character featuring violet leaf, nutmeg, honeysuckle, carnation, and sandalwood, producing its signature metallic-leather warmth. The dry down lands on a powerful, masculine base of leather, vetiver, amber, tonka bean, and patchouli, leaving a magnetic, unforgettable, and rugged trail.

Encased in Dior’s signature flask bottle styled with a fiery sunset gradient—transitioning from deep crimson red to glowing golden amber—this fragrance is a striking visual and olfactory statement — bold, revolutionary, and undeniably iconic.

PRODUCT INFORMATION

  • Brand: Dior

  • Collection Name: Fahrenheit

  • Size: 100 ml / 3.4 fl. oz.

  • Type: Eau de Toilette (EDT)

  • Gender: Men

  • Fragrance Family: Aromatic Leather / Woody-Floral

  • Launch Year: 1988

  • Base: Spray

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes: Lavender, Mandarin Orange, Hawthorn, Nutmeg Flower, Cedar, Bergamot, Chamomile, Lemon

  • Heart Notes: Violet Leaf, Nutmeg, Cedar, Sandalwood, Honeysuckle, Carnation, Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley

  • Base Notes: Leather, Vetiver, Amber, Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Musk

products.description:
Dior Addict Eau de Parfum is an intensely seductive, noble, and sophisticated fragrance that captures the essence of bold, independent femininity. Crafted by master perfumer François Demachy, this opulent oriental-floral scent revolves around a magnificent heart of night-blooming Cereus, creating a mysterious, warm, and addictive aura.

Opening with a vibrant, fresh burst of mandarin leaf and orange blossom, Dior Addict immediately sparks the senses with a luminous, green-citrus freshness. The heart reveals its intoxicating signature with an enchanting bouquet of Jasmin Sambac and night-blooming Cereus, delivering an exotic, rich floral intensity. The fragrance dries down into a smooth, sensual base of Bourbon vanilla and sandalwood, leaving a deep, velvety, and magnetic trail.

Encased in Dior’s iconic, deep night-blue glass column topped with a gleaming gold metallic cap, this bottle is a sleek, majestic visual and olfactory statement — dramatic, luxurious, and hauntingly beautiful.

  • Heart Notes: Jasmin Sambac, Night-Blooming Cereus

  • Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood

products.title: Hypotonic Poison Dior EDT
products.description:
Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau de Toilette is a legendary, magnetic, and mysterious fragrance that stands as an icon of modern perfumery. Created by master perfumer Annick Menardo, this captivating oriental scent is built around contrasting facets of bitter almond, opulent jasmine, and creamy vanilla, evoking the idea of a forbidden, intoxicating potion.

Opening with an intriguing burst of bitter almond, caraway, and coconut, Hypnotic Poison immediately intrigues the senses with a warm, nutty, and subtly spicy sweetness. The heart transitions into a rich, velvety floral bouquet of Sambac jasmine, tuberose, and lily-of-the-valley, radiating intense, mysterious femininity. The dry down unveils an addictive, cozy base of sensual vanilla, sandalwood, and jacaranda wood, leaving a lingering, unforgettable trail.

Encased in Dior’s iconic apple-shaped bottle coated in a deep, dark ruby red lacquer—resembling the enchanted forbidden fruit—this fragrance is a striking visual and olfactory statement — bold, seductive, and timelessly bewitching.

PRODUCT INFORMATION

  • Brand: Dior

  • Collection Name: Poison (Hypnotic Poison)

  • Size: 100 ml / 3.4 fl. oz.

  • Type: Eau de Toilette (EDT)

  • Gender: Women

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Vanilla / Gourmand-Spicy

  • Launch Year: 1998

  • Base: Spray

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes: Bitter Almond, Caraway, Coconut, Plum

  • Heart Notes: Sambac Jasmine, Tuberose, Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Jacaranda Wood, Musk

products.title: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Miss Dior Eau de Parfum is an enchanting, vibrant, and sensuous floral couture creation that celebrates love, hope, and beauty. Redesigned by Dior’s In-House Perfumer-Creator François Demachy, this iconic scent centers around a velvety, honeyed Centifolia rose, wrapped in a lush wave of colorful wildflowers that feels like an embroidered bouquet of thousand flowers.

Opening with a luminous, sparkling burst of lily-of-the-valley, peony, and iris, Miss Dior immediately captivates with a fresh, elegant, and powdery floral freshness. The heart blooms into an opulent, romantic centerpiece of Centifolia rose and apricot-accented peach, radiating pure warmth and modern femininity. The fragrance then settles into a soft, comforting base of Papua New Guinean vanilla, benzoin, tonka bean, and sandalwood, leaving a silky, tender, and sensual trail.

Encased in Dior's iconic glass bottle featuring a delicate, handcrafted couture fabric bow tied around the neck—woven with thousands of colorful threads—this fragrance is a stunning visual and olfactory statement — romantic, luxurious, and timelessly elegant.

  • Size: 100 ml / 3.4 fl. oz.

  • Type: Eau de Parfum

  • Gender: Women

  • Fragrance Family: Floral Powdery / Amber Floral

  • Launch Year: 2021 (Current Eau de Parfum formulation)

  • Base: Spray

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes: Lily-of-the-Valley, Peony Accord, Iris

  • Heart Notes: Centifolia Rose, Apricot, Peach

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Benzoin, Musk

products.title: Scandal Jean Paul Gaultier EDT Pour Homme
products.description:
Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette by Jean Paul Gaultier (launched in 2021) is a bold, addictive aromatic-oriental fragrance created by perfumers Quentin Bisch, Christophe Raynaud, and Nathalie Cetto. Famous for its regal, crown-topped bottle, it redefines modern sweet-masculine perfumery by pairing crisp aromatic notes with a rich, buttery burnt caramel core.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody / Aromatic Gourmand

  • Top Notes: Clary Sage and Mandarin Orange

  • Heart Notes: Caramel and Tonka Bean

  • Base Notes: Vetiver

Scent Character & Experience

  • Opening: Opens with a bright, energizing burst of juicy mandarin orange grounded by a clean, herbal-green clary sage. The aromatic top gives it an immediate fresh kick that balances the sweet notes underneath.

  • Mid-Drydown: The heart quickly shifts into a warm, indulgent gourmand state where smooth, buttery caramel melts together with roasted tonka bean. It builds a thick, sweet, and playful presence.

  • Base: Dries down to an earthy, woody foundation dominated by vetiver. The vetiver cuts through the heavy caramel sweetness, giving the scent a structured, distinctly masculine edge as it rests on the skin.

Best Uses & Performance

Attribute Details
Brand Name Jean Paul Gaultier
Gender Profile Masculine
Best Occasions Cold weather (Fall/Winter), clubbing, nightlife, date nights, casual evening events
Concentration Eau de Toilette (EDT)
Longevity Outstanding (approx. 8–10+ hours, unusually strong for an EDT)
Projection Heavy (creates a loud, room-filling gourmand scent trail)

products.title: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Extreme EDP Intense
products.description:
Flowerbomb Extreme Eau de Parfum Intense by Viktor&Rolf is an opulent, deeper, and more sensual evolution of the iconic original Flowerbomb DNA. Renowned for its amplified richness, it takes the signature explosive floral bouquet and wraps it in a thick, luxurious blanket of warm vanilla, rich amber, and precious woods.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Floral / Gourmand

  • Top Notes: Tea and Bergamot

  • Heart Notes: Orchid, Jasmine, Rose, Freesia, and Orange Blossom

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Patchouli, Benzoin, and Palm Tree

Scent Character & Experience

  • Opening: Opens with the familiar sparkling tea and bergamot freshness of the original, but it is immediately heavier, darker, and more syrupy right from the first spray.

  • Mid-Drydown: The heart explodes into a dense, velvety bouquet of white florals and roses. Cattleya orchid and jasmine dominate, feeling noticeably sweeter, smoother, and more concentrated than in the standard EDP.

  • Base: Dries down to a decadent, intoxicating finish. A heavy dose of creamy Madagascar vanilla, warm golden amber, and resinous benzoin completely envelops the patchouli, giving it a cozy, rich "cashmere" warmth.

Best Uses & Performance

Attribute Details
Brand Name Viktor&Rolf
Gender Profile Feminine
Best Occasions Cold weather (Fall/Winter), formal evening events, date nights, special occasions
Concentration Eau de Parfum Intense
Longevity Outstanding (approx. 9–12+ hours)
Projection Heavy to nuclear (creates an alluring, rich floral-vanilla trail)

products.title: Paco Rabanne Million Gold For Her EDP
products.description:
Million Gold For Her Eau de Parfum by Rabanne (launched in 2024) marks a bold new chapter for the brand's floral fragrance lineup. Created by perfumers Alienor Massenet, Suzy Le Helley, Nathalie Benareau, and Loc Dong, it is built around Rabanne's signature "Gilded Floral" concept—contrasting radiant white flowers with a metallic, mineral musk and warm woodiness.

  • Fragrance Family: Floral Woody / Metallic Amber

  • Top Notes: Rose, White Peach, and Mandarin

  • Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac and Ylang-Ylang

  • Opening: Opens with a bright, luminous splash of juicy white peach and sparkling mandarin, tempered by a soft, modern rose facet.

  • Mid-Drydown: The heart unfolds into a solar white-floral bouquet led by creamy jasmine sambac and rich ylang-ylang, giving the scent a lush, radiant golden presence.

products.title: 1 Million Royal Paco Rabanne for Men
products.description:
1 Million Royal Parfum by Rabanne (launched in 2023) is a modern, vibrant reimagining of the iconic 1 Million pillar, created by perfumers Quentin Bisch and Christophe Raynaud. It shifts away from the original’s heavy bubblegum-cinnamon sweetness toward a sleeker, more refined blend of invigorating fresh lavender, sweet woods, and a distinctive cedarwood-amber foundation.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir EDP
products.description:
Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum (launched in 2004) is one of the most iconic, dark, and seductive feminine fragrances in designer perfumery. Created by master perfumer Antoine Lie, it fuses warm, spicy top notes with a luscious, creamy white-floral heart and a sensual amber-woody base.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Oriental Floral / Warm Spicy

  • Top Notes: Pepper, Ginger, and Cardamom

  • Heart Notes: Gardenia, Orange Blossom, Peony, and Coconut Accord

  • Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, and Musk

Scent Character & Experience

  • Opening: Opens with a lively, warm kick of pepper, cardamom, and fresh ginger. The spice provides a sultry contrast right from the first spray.

  • Mid-Drydown: The heart transitions into an opulent white-floral bouquet dominated by lush gardenia and a creamy, subtle coconut nuance. This creates a velvety, tropical-luxe texture that feels deeply enticing.

  • Base: Dries down to a cozy, long-lasting foundation of rich sandalwood, warm amber, and clean musk that sits close to the skin like a warm veil.

Best Uses & Performance

Brand Name Versace
Gender Profile Feminine
Best Occasions Cold weather (Fall/Winter), evening wear, date nights, black-tie events

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau EDP Intense
products.description:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum (often referred to as the EDP Intense) is an intense, magnetic amber-woody fragrance for men launched in 2022 and created by master perfumer Quentin Bisch. It is a richer, darker, and more sensual evolution of the original Le Beau Eau de Toilette.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody (Tropical / Gourmand edge)

  • Gender: Men

Olfactory Notes

  • Top Notes: Pineapple, Iris, Cypress, and Ginger — providing an energetic, slightly crisp, and fruity-aromatic opening.

  • Heart Notes: Coconut and Woody Notes — introduces a rich, creamy, tropical coconut accord reminiscent of a luxury Piña Colada.

  • Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Amber, and Ambergris — dries down into a warm, deeply seductive, and sweet resinous finish.

Performance & Vibe

  • Scent Profile: Often described as a dark, dense, and tropical cocktail. While the original EDT is bright and fresh, the EDP Intense adds heavy doses of creaminess, woods, and warmth.

  • Longevity & Projection: Excellent performance. It is known as a powerhouse fragrance that easily lasts 8+ hours on skin with strong projection and high compliment factor.

  • Best Suited For: Cooler summer nights, spring/autumn evenings, and nightlife/dates where you want a sweet, attention-grabbing scent.

The Bottle

True to the iconic Jean Paul Gaultier aesthetic, the bottle comes in an athletic, sculpted male torso with a gorgeous dark-blue to black gradient fading downward, adorned simply with a golden fig leaf over modesty.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau EDT
products.description:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette (EDT) is a wildly popular, ultra-sunny, and fresh tropical fragrance for men. Launched in 2019 (created by perfumers Quentin Bisch and Sonia Constant), it is inspired by the Garden of Eden and is built around an addictive, mouth-watering coconut note.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Woody Aromatic (Tropical / Fresh)

  • Gender: Men

Olfactory Notes

  • Top Notes: Bergamot and Coconut Wood — gives an instant burst of bright, sparkling citrus mixed with clean, woody coconut freshness.

  • Heart Notes: Coconut and Green Notes — deepens the creamy, sun-drenched coconut core with a crisp, leafy outdoor freshness.

  • Base Notes: Tonka Bean — dries down into a warm, cozy, sweet, and slightly powdery-almond finish.

Performance & Vibe

  • Scent Profile: Think of a high-end luxury sunscreen mixed with a sweet tropical cocktail, fresh citrus, and green freshness. It is playful, flirtatious, casual, and distinctly sweet without being cloying.

  • Longevity & Projection: Solid moderate performance. It typically lasts around 6+ hours on skin with moderate projection for the first couple of hours, making it pleasant and unoffensive.

  • Best Suited For: Warm weather, summer days, beach trips, casual outdoor hangouts, and daytime wear.

The Bottle

The bottle features the signature Jean Paul Gaultier sculpted male torso, this time in a vibrant, translucent emerald-green glass, decorated only with a gold fig leaf over modesty.

products.title: YSL Y EDT
products.description:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette (EDT) is a clean, ultra-versatile, and high-energy aromatic-fougere fragrance for men. Launched in 2017 (and later reformulated/updated around 2022 to boost freshness and longevity), it was created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion to capture the spirit of modern drive, youth, and ambition.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Aromatic Fougere / Fresh Spicy

  • Gender: Men

Olfactory Notes

  • Top Notes: Aldehydes, Bergamot, Ginger, Lemon, and Mint — delivers an explosive, ultra-crisp, sparkling, and icy-fresh blast right out of the gate.

  • Heart Notes: Lavender, Geranium, Violet Leaf, and Clary Sage — brings a clean, aromatic, soapy-fresh, and slightly herbal backbone that keeps it sophisticated.

  • Base Notes: Ambergris, Musk, Cedar, Balsam Fir, and Frankincense — dries down into a modern, metallic-woody, and slightly salty-amber finish with great clean musk.

Performance & Vibe

  • Scent Profile: Often described as the ultimate "blue" compliment-getter. It balances a shower-gel clean freshness with a sharp, modern, metallic-ginger edge. It smells clean, confident, and effortlessly put-together.

  • Longevity & Projection: Excellent for an EDT. Thanks to modern aroma-chemicals, it easily pushes 7 to 8+ hours on skin with strong, energetic projection for the first few hours.

  • Best Suited For: Daily signature scent, the office, school, the gym, casual warm-weather days, and anytime you just want to smell fresh and approachable.

The Bottle

The bottle is sleek, heavy, and modern, made of clear glass with a sharp, minimalist silhouette featuring a striking metallic silver "Y" cutting into the glass on the side.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Intense
products.description:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Intense is a bold, deeply sensual, and warm amber-floral fragrance for women. Launched in 2020 as a richer, creamier evolution of the original Libre EDP, it amplifies the signature tension between clean, aromatic masculinity and opulent, sultry femininity.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Fougere / Warm Floral

  • Gender: Women

Olfactory Notes

  • Top Notes: French Lavender, Mandarin Orange, and Bergamot — provides a bright, crisp, and aromatic citrus opening.

  • Heart Notes: Moroccan Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac, Orchid Accord, and Lavender — introduces a lush, opulent floral core with a glowing, exotic warmth.

  • Base Notes: Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Ambergris, and Vetiver — dries down into a smooth, deeply velvety, golden vanilla-amber finish with a touch of earthiness.

Performance & Vibe

  • Scent Profile: While the original Libre is sharp and professional, the Intense version turns up the dial on vanilla, orchid, and amber resin. It smells like deep purple velvet edged in gold—rich, confident, empowering, and undeniably magnetic.

  • Longevity & Projection: Exceptional performance. It easily pushes past 8 to 10+ hours on skin with strong, enveloping sillage that leaves a memorable trail.

  • Best Suited For: Cooler fall and winter weather, crisp autumn nights, formal events, romantic dates, and anytime you want to make a powerful, sophisticated statement.

The Bottle

The heavy luxury bottle retains the iconic geometric silhouette, featuring an oversized, gold-wrapped metallic Cassandre (YSL) logo biting into the glass, accented by gold chains and an asymmetric black cap

products.title: YSL La Nuit DE L'Homme L'Intense EDP
products.description:
Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit de L'Homme L'Intense (often referred to simply as L'Intense) is a dark, powdery, and intensely seductive amber-floral fragrance for men. Launched in 2015, it takes the DNA of the legendary original La Nuit de L'Homme and pivots it into a more mysterious, elegant, and velvety direction by heavily featuring iris and vanilla.

Fragrance Profile

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Woody / Powdery Floral

  • Gender: Men

Olfactory Notes

  • Top Notes: Violet Leaf and Bergamot — opens with a dark, cool, and slightly green-powdery touch.

  • Heart Notes: Iris, Vanilla, and Sage — the star of the show; brings a rich, cosmetics-smooth, lipstick-like elegance mixed with creamy sweetness and herbal depth.

  • Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Patchouli, and Leather-like nuances — dries down into a warm, sensual, earthy, and deeply cozy finish.

Performance & Vibe

  • Scent Profile: Unlike the spicy-cardamom punch of the original EDT, L'Intense leans heavily into a sophisticated, powdery iris-vanilla combination (often compared in style to designer masterpieces like Dior Homme Intense). It feels dark, intimate, high-fashion, and mysterious.

  • Longevity & Projection: Solid performance for a date-night fragrance, generally lasting around 7+ hours on skin with a smooth, inviting scent bubble rather than an aggressive projection.

  • Best Suited For: Romantic dates, intimate evening settings, formal wear, and cold autumn or winter nights.

The Bottle

It follows the iconic cylindrical shape of the La Nuit de L'Homme line with its signature hexagonal cap, but the glass features a dramatic dark gradient that fades from a deep, smoky charcoal-brown at the top into a lighter amber hue at the base.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid is a creative twist on traditional fragrances, recognized as the House’s first ozonic floral gourmand scent. It brilliantly bridges the gap between fresh, airy brightness and rich, creamy warmth, inviting you to lean into personal expression and a dreamlike aura.

The composition revolves around a striking contrast between the opulent warmth of vanilla and an unexpected fresh breeze:

Bottle Design

True to the Gucci Flora legacy, the bottle is a work of art. It features the signature vibrant floral pattern associated with the line, cast in a striking, sunny yellow color scheme that mirrors the radiant, joyful energy of the orchid inside.

products.title: Dior Sauvage EDP(Eau De Parfum)
products.description:
Overview

Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum (EDP) is one of the world's most popular modern men's fragrances. Created by perfumer François Demachy, it takes the crisp, sharp DNA of the original Eau de Toilette and deepens it. Inspired by the desert at the magical hour of twilight, it balances cool freshness with warm, enveloping, and sensual nocturnal undertones.

Fragrance Profile & Notes

Sauvage EDP is an amber fougère fragrance known for introducing a smooth, sweet richness to the line without losing its trademark bite:

  • Top Notes: Reggio di Calabria Bergamot — Juicy, zesty, and intensely fresh, delivering an immediate spark of brightness.

  • Heart Notes: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, Star Anise, and Nutmeg — A rich, spicy, and aromatic core that adds a darker, more complex, and mysterious masculine character.

  • Base Notes: Ambroxan and Papua New Guinean Vanilla Absolute — A smooth wave of woody amber mixed with a subtle, smoky, and enveloping sweetness that softens the sharper edges of the spice.

Performance & Best Uses

  • Vibe: Confident, sensual, mysterious, and deeply magnetic.

  • Longevity & Sillage: Exceptional performance. It sits heavier on the skin than the EDT version, offering great projection and long-lasting staying power.

  • When to Wear: While versatile enough for daily wear, its warm vanilla and rich spice notes shine brightest during cooler weather, evenings, and special occasions or night outs.

products.title: Dior Sauvage EDT(Eau De Toilette)
products.description:
Overview

Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette (EDT) is the iconic fragrance that launched the modern Sauvage phenomenon. Created by perfumer François Demachy in 2015, it is inspired by wide-open spaces, desert landscapes under a blue sky, and raw, ozone-rich rocky atmospheres. It remains one of the best-selling and most widely recognized men's fragrances in the world.

Fragrance Profile & Notes

Sauvage EDT is classified as an aromatic fougère fragrance. It is famous for its powerful, high-contrast opening and clean, masculine dry down:

  • Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot and Pepper — An explosive, zesty, and sharp burst of citrus paired with a spicy kick that provides immediate, high-energy freshness.

  • Heart Notes: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, Pink Pepper, Vetiver, Patchouli, Geranium, and Elemi — A complex, aromatic, and herbal core that balances raw masculinity with a clean, barbershop-fresh elegance.

  • Base Notes: Ambroxan, Cedar, and Labdanum — A warm, woody, and slightly salty-amber backbone that anchors the fragrance and gives it a lingering, magnetic trail.

Performance & Best Uses

  • Vibe: Bold, ultra-clean, energetic, rugged, and instantly noticeable.

  • Longevity & Sillage: Excellent projection and strong sillage, especially in its first few hours. It is remarkably potent for an Eau de Toilette.

  • When to Wear: Highly versatile ("dumb reach"). It excels in warm weather, casual daytime settings, and the gym, but remains popular as a signature everyday scent year-round.

products.description:
Valentino Donna Born In Roma Ivory (part of the Born in Roma Rendez-Vous collection) is an Eau de Parfum for women.

The Fragrance Profile

Born In Roma Ivory is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance that rewrites the signature Born In Roma DNA with a softer, sweeter, and more cocooning profile. It blends radiant citrus with airy florals and a fluffy, creamy-sweet base.

  • Top Note: Green Mandarin (providing a fresh, zesty, and vibrant opening)

  • Aesthetic: The scent leans into a sweet-creamy, powdery, and comforting profile. While it features marshmallow and vanilla, it is balanced heavily by a prominent clean musk and bright orange blossom, keeping it from becoming overwhelmingly heavy or aggressively sugary.

  • Versatility: It works well across multiple seasons and transitions easily from day wear to intimate evening or date-night settings.

  • Bottle Design: True to the limited-edition Rendez-Vous line, the bottle is coated in a sophisticated, monochromatic matte ivory lacquer accented with signature Valentino golden details.

products.title: Valentino Born In Roma Extradose
products.description:
Valentino Donna Born In Roma Extradose Parfum is an intense, ultra-rich fragrance designed to push the signature Born in Roma DNA to its maximum depth and projection. Tailored for evening wear and cooler settings, it leans heavily into a warm, indulgent, and slightly boozy profile.

  • Fragrance Family: Amber Vanilla / Floral Oriental

  • Top Note: Cassis Accord (providing a dark, juicy fruit opening)

  • Base Note: Vanilla Extract (leaving a deep, creamy, and long-lasting trail)

Character & Performance
